name: How much does it cost to fix a running toilet?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a running toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair a running toilet can vary depending on the specific cause and the parts needed. Simple fixes like replacing a flapper valve might be less expensive than issues requiring a new fill valve assembly or more complex internal tank repairs. Homeowners in Goodyear, Buckeye, Avondale, or Surprise can expect a service call fee plus the cost of parts and labor. We provide an estimate after diagnosing the problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair costs vary based on the cause and parts needed, from simple flapper replacement to more complex valve issues. An estimate is provided after diagnosis.
